name: Ichihara Masaharu
source:
Masaharu is [url=/c54673]Yuuki's[/url] childhood friend and classmate with [url=/c54671]Chisa[/url], [url=/c61898]Rie[/url] and [url=/c69409]Koudai[/url]. Friendly with most people, it is quite easy to approach. Perhaps that's why [url=/c54672]Youko-senpai[/url], the president of the student council, who has been flirting with him since he arrived in high school, having as much physical contact as possible with him. But it was also thanks to this kindness that he was able to approach [url=/c54674]Sumire[/url] as she tried to approach a young cat and make a friend of her.

Unlike his best friend Yuuki, Masaharu is more than interested in love and would like to make a girlfriend but he has never had a chance to make one yet. But will his second year of high school be as unsuccessful as his first year?
